decisive_items: Serum parvovirus B19 (PVB19) IgM and IgG antibodies were detectable
PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/μg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen, but not in the serum
response.rationale: PVB19 DNA in lesional skin and positive serology directly implicate parvovirus B19, while erythema multiforme lacks typical target lesions and is less specific given the virologic evidence.

rejected.why: Clinical features overlap but no target lesions and PVB19 detection in skin biopsy strongly favors parvovirus B19 infection.
